description: List the shoes, bikes and other gear on the Garmin account, active first: uuid, name, type, status (active or retired), total distance and activity count, the distance limit set in Garmin, in use since, retired date and notes. Use it for "how many km on my shoes" or "which shoes to replace", not for watches and sensors (get_devices); name or uuid is what update_activity takes as add_gear/remove_gear. Returns every item, no paging; none recorded gives an empty list.

include_activities.description: true: add the last 10 activities per item (date, name, distance) to see what the gear was used for

name: get_gear
title: Get gear
